name: Lozz Cake - Search Order in PostgreSQL

parameters.jsCode: const b=$input.first().json.body??{}; const orderCode=String(b.orderCode??'').trim(); const phone=String(b.phone??'').trim(); const digits=phone.replace(/\\D/g,''); if(!orderCode||!phone) return [{json:{valid:false,success:false,message:'من فضلك أدخل كود الطلب ورقم الموبايل.'}}]; if(digits.length<10||digits.length>13) return [{json:{valid:false,success:false,message:'رقم الموبايل غير صحيح.'}}]; return [{json:{valid:true,orderCode,phone}}];

parameters.query:
WITH req AS (
 SELECT LOWER(BTRIM($1::text)) AS code,
 CASE
  WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE($2::text,''), '\D','','g'))=12
   AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE($2::text,''), '\D','','g'),2)='20'
   THEN '0'||SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE($2::text,''), '\D','','g') FROM 3)
  WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE($2::text,''), '\D','','g'))=10
   AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE($2::text,''), '\D','','g'),1)='1'
   THEN '0'||REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE($2::text,''), '\D','','g')
  ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE($2::text,''), '\D','','g')
 END AS phone
),
matched AS (
 SELECT o.* FROM public.orders o CROSS JOIN req r
 WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(o.order_code))=r.code
 AND (
  CASE
   WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(o.customer_phone,''), '\D','','g'))=12
    AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(o.customer_phone,''), '\D','','g'),2)='20'
    THEN '0'||SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(o.customer_phone,''), '\D','','g') FROM 3)
   WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(o.customer_phone,''), '\D','','g'))=10
    AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(o.customer_phone,''), '\D','','g'),1)='1'
    THEN '0'||REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(o.customer_phone,''), '\D','','g')
   ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(o.customer_phone,''), '\D','','g')
  END
 )=r.phone
 ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 1
),
a AS (
 SELECT order_id, JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
  'productId',product_id,'productName',product_name,'unit',unit,
  'quantity',quantity,'unitPriceEGP',unit_price_egp,
  'designExtraEGP',design_extra_egp,'totalEGP',total_egp
 ) ORDER BY id) AS items
 FROM public.order_addons WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM matched) GROUP BY order_id
),
i AS (
 SELECT order_id, JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
  'id',id,'imageType',image_type,'fileName',file_name,'objectKey',object_key,
  'mimeType',mime_type,'fileSizeBytes',file_size_bytes
 ) ORDER BY id) AS items
 FROM public.order_images WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM matched)
 AND is_active=TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
 (o.id IS NOT NULL) AS success,
 CASE WHEN o.id IS NULL THEN 'لم يتم العثور على طلب مطابق لكود الطلب ورقم الموبايل.'
 ELSE 'تم العثور على الطلب.' END AS message,
 CASE WHEN o.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
 'id',o.id,'orderCode',o.order_code,'name',o.customer_name,'phone',o.customer_phone,
 'moderatorName',o.moderator_name,'fulfillmentMethod',o.fulfillment_method,
 'city',o.city,'area',o.area,'addressDetails',o.address_details,
 'deliveryDate',o.delivery_date,'deliveryTimeFrom',o.delivery_time_from,
 'deliveryTimeTo',o.delivery_time_to,'cakeType',o.cake_type,'cakeSize',o.cake_size,
 'dimensions',o.dimensions,'numberOfTiers',o.number_of_tiers,'filling',o.filling,
 'covering',o.covering,'details',o.details,'basePriceEGP',o.base_price_egp,
 'cakeDesignExtraEGP',o.cake_design_extra_egp,'addOnsTotalEGP',o.addons_total_egp,
 'addOns',COALESCE(a.items,'[]'::jsonb),'deliveryFeeEGP',o.delivery_fee_egp,
 'discountType',o.discount_type,'discountInputValue',o.discount_input_value,
 'discountAmountEGP',o.discount_amount_egp,'totalOrderEGP',o.total_order_egp,
 'depositEGP',0,'remainingEGP',o.total_order_egp,
 'orderSummary',o.order_summary,'submittedAt',o.submitted_at,
 'createdAt',o.created_at,'updatedAt',o.updated_at,
 'images',COALESCE(i.items,'[]'::jsonb),
 'cakeImages',COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(x.value) FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(COALESCE(i.items,'[]'::jsonb)) x(value) WHERE x.value->>'imageType'='cake'),'[]'::jsonb),
 'depositImages',COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(x.value) FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(COALESCE(i.items,'[]'::jsonb)) x(value) WHERE x.value->>'imageType'='deposit'),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) END AS "order"
FROM (SELECT 1) seed LEFT JOIN matched o ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN i ON i.order_id=o.id;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first()?.json??{}; if(r.success!==true||!r.order) return [{json:{success:false,message:r.message||'لم يتم العثور على طلب مطابق لكود الطلب ورقم الموبايل.'}}]; return [{json:{success:true,message:r.message||'تم العثور على الطلب.',order:r.order}}];
